title: Local Weak Limits for Equilibrium and Risk in Economic Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.27107v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study equilibrium and risk evaluation in large sparse economic networks with heterogeneous responses, shocks, and bilateral exposures. Our approach approximates the distribution of equilibrium outcomes through local computations on a limiting rooted network. Under marked local weak convergence, we prove convergence in probability of the empirical equilibrium distribution in two settings: uniformly contractive responses and bounded monotone nonexpansive responses whose lower and upper root iterations coalesce. In the latter setting, the limit is independent of the measurable finite-network equilibrium selection, even when equilibria are not unique. Under bounded domain and continuity assumptions, this convergence extends to law-invariant risk measures, including conditional value-at-risk, with recursion-depth error bounds under additional regularity. Numerical experiments on production networks and payment clearing systems illustrate

translated_title: 经济网络中均衡与风险的局部弱极限
translated_abstract: 我们研究具有异质响应、冲击和双边敞口的大型稀疏经济网络中的均衡与风险评估问题。我们的方法通过在极限有根网络上进行局部计算来近似均衡结果的分布。在标记局部弱收敛条件下，我们在两种情形下证明了经验均衡分布的依概率收敛：一致压缩响应，以及下、上不动点迭代相互重合的有界单调非扩张响应。在后一情形中，即使均衡不唯一，极限也与有限网络上可测的均衡选择规则无关。在有界域和连续性假设下，该收敛结果可进一步推广至律不变风险测度，包括条件风险价值（CVaR），并在额外正则性条件下给出递归深度误差界。在生产网络与支付清算系统上的数值实验展示了该方法的应用效果。
tldr: 该论文利用标记局部弱收敛方法，通过在极限有根网络上的局部计算近似均衡结果分布，证明了大型稀疏经济网络中经验均衡分布的依概率收敛，并将其推广至条件风险价值等律不变风险测度。
en_tdlr: This paper proves convergence in probability of the empirical equilibrium distribution in large sparse economic networks via marked local weak convergence, using local computations on a limiting rooted network, and extends the result to law-invariant risk measures such as conditional value-at-risk.
